source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted guide uses objects.inv from a built documentation tree to find document references. Page links use a leading-slash document target such as /documentation/index. The current guide separately shows a named section label such as sqlitedirectory without that slash. Source file paths and version-specific published URLs are not interchangeable with those targets. Missing references can become plain text or build warnings. No documentation build or rendered link validation ran here.
title: Documentation page targets and named-section labels use different links
